Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for your email. Insperity Organizational Planning can display photos of employees in the chart boxes and in the profile card so that employees can ‘put a face with a name’.
You can view our job aid here for assistance with adding photos. If you have any additional questions or if I can be of further assistance, please let me know.
Thank you,
